package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	examplerelationuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/examplerelation"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

// ExampleRelationsHandler handles semantic links between lesson examples.
type ExampleRelationsHandler struct {
	ListUC examplerelationuc.ListExampleRelations
	Access contentaccess.Service
}

func (h ExampleRelationsHandler) ListPublic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.Access.RequireExample(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "sourceExampleID"), ""); err != nil {
		writeContentAccessError(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.list(w, r, true)
}

func (h ExampleRelationsHandler) list(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, activeOnly bool) {
	relations, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "sourceExampleID"), activeOnly)
	if err != nil {
		writeLessonExampleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"example_relations": relations})
}
